messages:
Maya C: Quick capture from VentureCore onboarding call earlier today — dumping raw notes for triage. Please flag renewal-impact items.

Liam R: thanks Maya, paste the details.

Maya C: Raw asks + customer quotes: 
- Index freshness: bulk import reported as 'completed' but new docs not searchable for ~6 hours. Quote: "We uploaded in the morning and didn't see anything until the afternoon — demo stalled."
- Search relevance/regression: after the patch some queries return older docs above newly added ones, demo failure risk.
- Per-team quota request: they want a soft cap per team with email warning + webhook on approaching usage.
- Import reliability: during a 50k import they saw intermittent 502s and ~1.8% of docs dropped without retries.

Aisha P: Routing suggestion: freshness -> infra/serving; relevance -> product-ml + evals; quotas -> billing/product; import reliability -> eng-runtime.

Priya: Prioritize freshness and relevance as P1 for this customer (renewal watch). Quotas and retries are P2.

Tom: Can we get repro artifacts? timestamps of uploads, example queries, request ids. I'll try to repro the 502s in staging.

Maya C: Upload details from VentureCore: job name vc_50k_2026-04-21, upload started 2026-04-21T09:03:14Z, they ran query at 09:15 and got zero results; first sighting at 15:40 next day in their dashboard.

ops-bot: Created CS-5102: VentureCore index freshness (https://redwood.atlassian/CS-5102)
ops-bot: Created CS-5103: VentureCore search relevance regression (https://redwood.atlassian/CS-5103)

Liam R: I'll attach the CSV + sample queries to CS-5102 by EOD. Also collecting the failing query examples for CS-5103.

Aisha P: Infra, please add ingest pipeline traces and KV cache invalidation logs; suspect cache TTL or async indexing lag.

Tom: Quick snippet customer pasted:
```
2026-04-21T09:03:14Z start upload job=vc_50k batch=1 user=vc_admin
2026-04-21T09:03:18Z ingest ready shards=16 job=vc_50k
2026-04-21T09:03:19Z write->index queue=write-buffer delayed
2026-04-21T09:03:21Z 502 upstream read_timeout id=xyz987
2026-04-21T09:03:21Z retry schedule id=xyz987 attempts=1
2026-04-21T15:40:02Z query get_results qid=abc123 returned=5
```

Priya: For Friday product sync propose weighting: renewal_risk=3, demo_impact=2, engineering_effort=2. We'll surface CS-5102/CS-5103 with that matrix.

Maya C: Customer language: "If indexing delays continue we'll pause the pilot and re-evaluate vendors." Marking account health: onboarding_at_risk, renewal_watch.

Liam R: Action items: attach logs & CSV to CS-5102 (Liam) by EOD; infra tracing (Aisha) by tomorrow morning; Priya will present prioritization Friday; Tom will run a staging import repro.

Tom: Starting staging run now and will post results here.

Maya C: Thanks team — I'll update the VentureCore playbook and send the customer an acknowledgement and ETA. :pray:
